classified domain contains all 127 almost simple groups of order at most one
million, with 10,694 subgroup-class rows. Seven larger applications contribute

the stronger companion socle-order bound, or every attributed sporadic output.

algorithms and the retained classification and software interfaces remain
attributed. This ordinary corrected recovery adds no measurement, principal
